title: Malik Willis: I wasn't prepared to start when I entered the league, I've grown a lot

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Malik Willis: I wasn't prepared to start when I entered the league, I've grown a lot
sources.description: Malik Willis has only thrown 155 passes over the course of his NFL career, but the last 89 of them came in front of Dolphins head coach Jeff Hafley and General Manager Jon-Eric Sullivan and they helped convince Miami to sign him to a three-year contract this week.
